_comment: Terms that must NEVER be translated in any language. Estonian and Russian SEO practitioners use the English forms; translating them makes reports less usable, not more. The translate pass is instructed to preserve these verbatim.

notes.htmlTags:
HTML tags and attributes (

,

, rel="canonical", lang="et") stay verbatim in all languages.
notes.urls: URLs, file paths and slugs are never translated or transliterated.
notes.statusCodes: HTTP status codes (200, 301, 404) stay as numerals.
notes.units: Keep KB/KiB/MB/ms/s as-is. Localise only the decimal separator: 5.2 s → 5,2 s (et, ru).
